newsitem.title: USA: Universal Automotive Q3 sales up 35 pct.
newsitem.headline: Universal Automotive Q3 sales up 35 pct.

text.p: Universal Automotive Industries Inc said Thursday its third-quarter sales rose 35 percent, to $17.1 million from $12.7 million a year earlier.
For the nine months, it said sales were $50.1 million, up 46 percent from the same 1995 period.
Sales grew mainly due to continued growth in brake parts through increased market penetration, it said.

Universal said overall sales growth remains strong despite a significant decline in the Chicago warehouse/distribution business. The decline was due to termination of lower margin non-brake product lines to provide added capacity to handle the brake parts business.
